title: Exotic Smoky Moroccan Chicken Tagine
description: A charred, molten, post-workout Moroccan dish featuring chicken, spices, and a unique pasta water emulsion, served with Oreo cream biscuits on the side.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 400 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together olive oil, smoked paprika, ground cumin, and ground coriander.
Add the chicken to the bowl and toss to coat with the spice mixture.
Transfer the chicken to a large Dutch oven and cook over medium high heat until browned on all sides.
Add the canned diced tomatoes, pasta water, salt, and black pepper to the Dutch oven and stir to combine.
Cover the Dutch oven and transfer to the preheated oven.
Bake for 30 minutes or until the chicken is cooked through and the sauce has thickened.
While the tagine is baking, open the package of Oreo cream biscuits and set aside.
Remove the tagine from the oven and let cool for a few minutes before serving with the Oreo cream biscuits on the side.
